'''Aygion Mountain''' was a major [[City/Legends|city]] located on a [[Aygion Mountain (mountain)|mountain]] of the same name on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. It served as the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and contained the [[First Temple of Doellin]].<ref name="SoR" />
